zh.Start the Electron desktop app to connec: 请通过 Electron 桌面应用启动；普通浏览器不能连接编程后端。
zh.Codex is not signed in. Run codex login,: Codex 尚未登录。请先在终端运行 codex login，再点击连接。
zh.Connect to Codex using the setup button: 还未连接 Codex，请点击对话框上方的连接按钮。
请先选择项目目录，再发送消息。
zh.Pass clicks through transparent areas: 透明区域可直接操作桌面
zh.YOUR IDEAS, OUR NEXT CHAPTER: 让想法成为下一段故事
zh.Where your project begins: 代码与故事开始的地方
角色陪你交流 · 执行由 Codex 完成
zh.Run codex login first. Official Codex ma: 先在终端运行 codex login。登录信息由官方 Codex 管理。
zh.Connect to Codex on PATH: 连接 PATH 中的 Codex
zh.Permissions for new or resumed conversat: 新建 / 恢复会话的权限
zh.Project write (can modify the selected f: 项目内写入（可修改选中目录）
zh.Choose a project and start a new convers: 切换权限前请先选择项目，开始新会话。项目写入不会逐文件询问，越界操作仍由 Codex 审批。
zh.Personality for new or resumed conversat: 凛的性格 · 应用于新建 / 恢复会话
zh.Voice uses system TTS. Available voices: 语音使用系统 TTS；可用中文声音取决于 Windows。示例口型为近似节奏动画，不是音素同步。
zh.Drag to move. Double-click to toggle cha: 双击显示或收起对话；使用上方 ⠿ 拖动窗口
zh.Ready for your next idea: 准备好迎接下一个想法
zh.Tell me your idea. We can explore a proj: 把想法告诉我吧。我们可以从读懂一个项目开始，
也可以一起做出一个小小的新东西。
zh.Help me understand this project: 先帮我了解这个项目的结构
zh.Review my changes for potential issues: 检查当前修改，找出潜在问题
zh.This is a welcome message. Connected rep: 这是一段欢迎语。连接后，回复和执行事件均来自真实 Codex。
zh.Codex connected; choose a project: Codex 已连接，尚未选择项目
zh.Choose a project folder to send messages: 选择项目目录后即可发送消息。当前默认只读，不会自动修改文件。
zh.Connect to Codex and choose project: 连接 Codex 并选择项目
zh.Write your idea, then connect using the: 可以先输入想法，再点击上方连接按钮……
zh.Choose a project using the button above…: 请先点击上方按钮选择项目目录……
zh.Task running; you can stop at any time: 任务执行中，可随时停止
zh.Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new: Enter 发送 · Shift + Enter 换行
zh.Check execution records · Permissions ar: 执行结果以右侧记录为准 · 不会自动批准权限请求
zh.Tool calls, command output and changes: 工具调用、命令输出与代码改动
zh.No diff received for this turn. Open fil: 本轮尚未收到 diff。历史文件修改可在进度中的 fileChange 记录查看。
zh.The latest 500 raw events. Codex stores: 最近 500 条原始协议事件；更多记录由 Codex 线程保存。
Codex 可以修改选中的项目。
zh.You decide approvals. Failures are shown: 审批决定由你作出。失败会如实显示。
zh.{name} will wait. This is the original r: {name}会等你。以下是 Codex 发来的原始请求。
zh.Unknown requests can only be declined. N: 未知请求只会拒绝；本 MVP 不提供永久授权或自动批准。
zh.Local images stay on this computer. Tran: 图片只保存在本机，推荐使用透明 PNG。
zh.A single image uses frame 0 for every st: 单张图片的所有状态均使用第 0 帧；图集帧号从 0 开始。
zh.Auto-hide at screen edges: 靠近屏幕边缘自动收起
zh.Drag the character to move it. Alt + whe: 拖动人物即可移动，Alt + 滚轮可缩放；点击边缘标签即可展开。
zh.Changes apply to new or resumed conversa: 语言和性格设置应用于新建或恢复的会话；已有消息及工具输出保持原文。
zh.error.imageSize: 图片太大，请使用不超过 15 MB 的图片。
zh.error.imageType: 请使用有效的 PNG、JPEG 或 WebP 图片。
zh.error.imageDimensions: 图片边长不能超过 8192 像素。
zh.error.imageGrid: 图集需为 1–8 行、1–8 列且能够等分图片，帧号必须有效。
zh.error.position: 无效的人物位置或大小。
zh.error.busy: 请先等待本轮结束，或停止任务。
zh.error.executable: 请通过选择器选择官方 codex.exe。
zh.error.projectThread: 该会话不属于当前项目。
zh.Choose the project Codex may work on: 选择 Codex 可以工作的项目
zh.Articulated vector mode: continuous join: 二维关节模式：连续动作、眨眼、视线与表情，无需 Live2D 模型。
zh.error.approvalDecision: 只支持单次批准、拒绝或取消。
zh.Only an idle image is required. Any miss: 只需要一张待机图；未上传的动作会自动使用待机图。
zh.Upload separate images for the actions y: 按需为各动作上传图片。建议使用相同画布尺寸和人物位置，让切换更自然。
zh.One idle image is enough. Other actions: 一张待机图即可开始，其他动作图片均可选。
zh.error.action: 请选择有效的动作；待机图不能移除，请直接更换。

en.Start the Electron desktop app to connec: Start the Electron desktop app to connect to Codex.
en.Codex is not signed in. Run codex login,: Codex is not signed in. Run codex login, then connect again.
en.Connect to Codex using the setup button: Connect to Codex using the setup button before sending.
Choose a project folder before sending.
en.Run codex login first. Official Codex ma: Run codex login first. Official Codex manages sign-in.
en.Permissions for new or resumed conversat: Permissions for new or resumed conversations
en.Project write (can modify the selected f: Project write (can modify the selected folder)
en.Choose a project and start a new convers: Choose a project and start a new conversation to change permissions. Project writes are not approved file by file; Codex handles boundary approvals.
en.Personality for new or resumed conversat: Personality for new or resumed conversations
en.Voice uses system TTS. Available voices: Voice uses system TTS. Available voices depend on Windows. Accurate lip sync is not implemented.
en.Drag to move. Double-click to toggle cha: Drag to move. Double-click to toggle chat. Alt + wheel to resize.
en.What would you like to build?: What would you like to build?
en.Tell me your idea. We can explore a proj: Tell me your idea. We can explore a project
en.Review my changes for potential issues: Review my changes for potential issues
en.Help me build a new feature: Help me build a new feature
en.This is a welcome message. Connected rep: This is a welcome message. Connected replies and execution events come from real Codex.
en.Choose a project folder to send messages: Choose a project folder to send messages. The default mode is read-only.
en.Connect to Codex and choose project: Connect to Codex and choose project
en.Write your idea, then connect using the: Write your idea, then connect using the button above…
en.Choose a project using the button above…: Choose a project using the button above…
en.Task running; you can stop at any time: Task running; you can stop at any time
en.Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new: Enter to send · Shift + Enter for a new line
en.Check execution records · Permissions ar: Check execution records · Permissions are never automatically approved
en.Tool calls, command output and changes: Tool calls, command output and changes
en.No diff received for this turn. Open fil: No diff received for this turn. Open fileChange records to inspect earlier edits.
en.The latest 500 raw events. Codex stores: The latest 500 raw events. Codex stores additional thread history.
Codex may modify the selected project.
en.You decide approvals. Failures are shown: You decide approvals. Failures are shown honestly.
en.{name} will wait. This is the original r: {name} will wait. This is the original request from Codex.
en.Unknown requests can only be declined. N: Unknown requests can only be declined. No permanent or automatic approvals.
en.Local images stay on this computer. Tran: Local images stay on this computer. Transparent PNG is recommended.
en.A single image uses frame 0 for every st: A single image uses frame 0 for every state. Frame numbers start at 0.
en.Drag the character to move it. Alt + whe: Drag the character to move it. Alt + wheel resizes it. Click the edge tab to restore.
en.Changes apply to new or resumed conversa: Changes apply to new or resumed conversations. Existing messages and tool output are not translated.
en.error.imageSize: Choose an image no larger than 15 MB.
en.error.imageType: Choose a valid PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
en.error.imageDimensions: Image dimensions must not exceed 8192 pixels.
en.error.imageGrid: Use a divisible 1–8 row/column grid and valid frame indexes.
en.error.busy: Wait for this turn to finish or stop it first.
en.error.executable: Choose the official codex.exe using the file picker.
en.error.projectThread: This conversation belongs to a different project.
en.Choose the project Codex may work on: Choose the project Codex may work on
en.Articulated vector mode: continuous join: Articulated vector mode: continuous joints, blinking, gaze and expressions. No Live2D model required.
en.error.approvalType: This request requires a dedicated response.
en.error.approvalDecision: Only one-time approval, decline or cancel is supported.
en.error.unavailableDecision: The server did not offer this decision.
en.Only an idle image is required. Any miss: Only an idle image is required. Any missing action uses the idle image automatically.
en.Upload separate images for the actions y: Upload separate images for the actions you want. Use the same canvas and alignment for smooth transitions.
en.One idle image is enough. Other actions: One idle image is enough. Other actions are optional.
en.error.action: Choose a valid action. Replace the required idle image instead of removing it.
